models.title: Ducted Grill — Teppanyaki with Integrated Exhaust Duct
models.description_en: This grill incorporates ducts into the main unit and includes an exhaust function, making it suitable for stores that do not want to install exhaust ducts on the ceiling for design reasons. The suction fan is located several meters away, making it quiet. Additionally, it uses a quiet-type fan motor to deliver airflow, minimizing noise in the dining area. It includes an automatic fire extinguishing system that can immediately extinguish fires in case of emergencies within the ducts. It is installed in establishments such as hotels that offer face-to-face service (e.g. Signature Restaurant "Yasaka", Park Hyatt Kyoto).

models.title: Custom Design — Teppanyaki Custom-Sized to Fit the Kitchen Counter
models.description_en: This is a tabletop grill that can be installed according to kitchen size. The thickness of the steel plate can be changed to suit the usage requirements (standard 19mm). The heat retention of the iron plate minimizes temperature drops. You can choose between digital and analog temperature control settings. The entire cooking surface is made of a steel plate; since it is flat, the perimeter of the plate has groove processing to prevent oil from flowing out. The surrounding area is made of stainless steel sheet metal, which prevents the surrounding area from becoming hot due to heat conduction.
